No submitted-answer grade is supplied. q-121252 is ambiguous only as to a unique choice token: -3xy≥0 is equivalent to xy≤0, including quadrants II and IV and both axes. Both current options 2 and 3 visibly represent this region; option 2 is mathematically valid, but the captured solution does not distinguish the duplicate choices. All other fields are confirmed by their respective worked solutions. For q-317169, odd powers preserve signs, yielding −,+,+,−. Taylor coefficients are f^(k)(a)/k!: q-8269 has coefficients 2^(3/2), −9/√2, and 27/(8√2); q-15638 has centered coefficients 6/5, −1/25, and 1/125; q-51238 has centered coefficients 1,1,1,1/2; q-15374 has cubic coefficient −1/16. For q-49315, integrating the net pressure rate 4t−(t+2)=3t−2 with initial pressure 6 gives 3t²/2−2t+6. For q-103776, 2000+(e^12−e^4)/2≈83350.10, agreeing with 83,350. q-35833 behaves like 4x−25, and q-68075 behaves like 7x²/12, so neither has a horizontal asymptote at either infinity. q-49348 and q-73329 require negating their signed integrals because the curves lie below the axis, giving areas 2 and π/2. The q-73329 source initially labels the negative signed integral A; its final positive area corrects that notation. q-87876 would require e^(3x)<−6, impossible for real x. q-87895 is equivalent to 28<12^x, giving x>ln(28)/ln(12), equal to the listed logarithmic expression. For q-81685, sin²(x)=(1−cos(2x))/2 gives x²−x⁴/3. Its source mistakenly labels the derivative 2cos(2x) as f′ instead of f″; the final answer is correct. q-126365 follows from the logarithm series and gives x−x²/2+x³/3−x⁴/4.
